title.zh: 转移分节恢复编码词序列
title.en: Transition grouping recovers encoded word sequences

claim.zh: 对每个字母表与每个相邻关系 r：由右向左读，元素在 r 把它连到其后一组的首元素时并入该组，否则另起一组；分组返回一个划分，当且仅当各组非空、内部依 r 相连且不连到下一组，该划分唯一，分组不改变序列。对非空词的词汇，分组恢复每个编码序列的词，当且仅当每个词内部相连，且任何词的末元素都不连到任何词的首元素——两项都是相邻对的局部条件。以观察转移的严格多数学得的关系使每个元素至多连到一个后继。已有的分节算法与二词编码即这些定义：恢复每个二词序列恰当 a→b、c→d 相连而 b→a、b→c、d→a、d→c 不相连；idealBond 与接触史实际取得的关系是实例。
claim.en: For every alphabet and every adjacency relation r: reading from the right, an element joins the following group where r links it to that group's first element and opens a new group otherwise; grouping returns a partition exactly when every group is nonempty, linked by r inside and not linked to the next, that partition is unique, and grouping never changes the sequence. For a vocabulary of nonempty words, grouping recovers the words of every encoded sequence exactly when each word is linked inside and the last element of no word is linked to the first element of any word — both local conditions on adjacent pairs. A relation learned as the strict majority of observed transitions links each element to at most one successor. The existing grouping algorithm and two-word encoding are these definitions: every two-word sequence is recovered exactly when a→b and c→d are linked and b→a, b→c, d→a, d→c are not; idealBond and the relation an encounter history actually acquires are instances.

hypotheses.zh: 一般律对字母表与相邻关系不加条件；实例使用四个基本事件、二词编码及 idealBond。
hypotheses.en: The general law places no condition on the alphabet or relation; the instance uses four elementary events, the two-word encoding and idealBond.

hypotheses.zh: 实际取得见证使用既定接触序列、严格多数判准与足够记录支持。
hypotheses.en: The acquisition witness uses the stated encounter sequence, strict-majority criterion and adequate recording support.

correspondence.zh: 该关系是日志中已观察转移的分节判准；声音分类与语言对应没有由此推导。
correspondence.en: The relation is a grouping criterion derived from observed transitions in a log; sound categories and linguistic correspondence are not derived.

detail.zh: 重复可合并预定词界；部分经历只支持一个表达而误分另一表达。
detail.en: Repetition can merge intended boundaries; partial experience can parse one expression while misgrouping another.

detail.zh: 严格多数学得的关系是函数式的：两个词若在内部以不同元素接续同一元素，任何转移记录都不能把两者都分对。
detail.en: A relation learned by strict majority is functional: where two words continue one element differently inside, no record of transitions groups both.

limitations.zh: 分组规则固定；任意长度形式对应不保证有限支持下实际执行，不建立自然语言或完整认知。
limitations.en: The grouping rule is fixed; arbitrary-length correspondence does not guarantee affordable execution or establish natural language and complete cognition.

validation_scope.zh: 迁移既有23项定理／51项声明审计中的指定分节结果；不因登记新增成果或重跑证明。
validation_scope.en: Migrates the specified grouping result from the existing 23-theorem/51-audit package; registration adds no theorem or proof rerun.

next_delta.zh: 直接复用词划分，接到后续绑定或解释；不要把再次调用计作新分节成果。
next_delta.en: Reuse the partition for subsequent binding or interpretation; another invocation is not a new grouping result.

history.en: 2026-10-14: under the general-law audit of older records, the claim now states the law first (new core module Becoming.Segmentation): for every alphabet and relation, grouping gives a unique partition and recovers words exactly under local conditions, and strict-majority relations are functional; the existing algorithm, two-word encoding and idealBond become instances through the bridge Becoming.Instances and the periphery MachineInstances. Built with scratch_build; core and bridge have empty axiom reports, the periphery standard axioms only; the landing run binds the receipts. The original theorems, receipt and counterexamples are unchanged.

history.zh: 2026-10-16，P114 散立的模块在共同基底上陈述（研究 §138；Ren 2026-10-15：“so for our theories, they are proved in a dag order and can be all connected right?”）：主律在共同基底上陈述，不加前提：每个词都是过程从 s 回到 s 的历程时，按 r 分组恢复每个由词组成之历程的词，恰当每个词内部相连、且没有词的末一步与任何词的首一步相连（course_words_iff）；一个历程诸步的分组唯一（course_chunks_iff）；两个词在内部以不同的方式延续同一步时，任何过程的任何运行前 n 步的记录按其多数联结分组都漏掉某个由词组成的历程（no_run_record_groups）。Becoming.Courses 由核心运行编译与审计（回执 20261015T172257.067968Z），公理报告为空。论断、假设、Ren 的话、依赖与既有证明不变；只加引用、绑定、别名与本条。
history.en: 16 October 2026, P114, the apart modules read on the shared base (study section 138; Ren, 15 October: “so for our theories, they are proved in a dag order and can be all connected right?”): the main law stated on the shared base, no premise added: where every word is a course of a process from s back to s, grouping by r recovers the words of every course of words exactly when each word is linked inside and no word's last move is linked to any word's first (course_words_iff); the grouping of a course's moves is unique (course_chunks_iff); where two words continue one move differently inside, grouping by the majority bonds of the record of the first n moves of any run of any process misses some course of words (no_run_record_groups). Becoming.Courses is compiled and audited by the core run (receipt 20261015T172257.067968Z), with empty axiom reports. Claims, hypotheses, Ren's words, dependencies and the earlier proofs are unchanged; only references, bindings, aliases and this entry are added.
